snippet.title: Tabaahi 🔥| Toxic (Hindi) | Rocking Star Yash, Kiara Advani, Tara Sutaria| Vishal Mishra, Raj Shekhar
snippet.description:
Tabaahi ❤️✨ — a melody that speaks straight to the heart.

Featuring Yash and Kiara Advani, this soulful track is beautifully sung and composed by Vishal Mishra. Let its heartfelt lyrics and mesmerizing melody stay with you long after the music ends. 🎶

🎵 𝗦𝗼𝗻𝗴 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗱𝗶𝘁𝘀
Song: Tabaahi
Movie: Toxic
Vocal & Composition: Vishal Mishra
Lyrics: Raj Shekhar
Music Assistants: Kumar Gaurav Singh, Trihangku Lahkar, Bitupon Boruah & Kandarpa Kalita
Music Production: Vishal Mishra, Bitupon Boruah, Kandarpa Kalita & Trihangku Lahkar
Guitars: Kandarpa Kalita
Drums: Trihangku Lahkar
Synths: Kandarpa Kalita & Bitupon Boruah
Backing Vocals: Kandarpa Kalita, Bitupon Boruah & Trihangku Lahkar
Brass & Woodwinds Arranged by: Vishal Mishra 
Dubbed in Prague by: Steve Ferry 
Vocal Dub Coordinator: Santhosh Venky
Recorded & Mixed by Trihangku Lahkar @VMS
Mastered by Dave Kutch at The Mastering Palace

🎬 𝗖𝗮𝘀𝘁 & 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝘄
Starring: Yash, Kiara Advani, Nayanthara, Huma Qureshi, Tara Sutaria & Rukmini Vasanth
Written by: Yash & Geetu Mohandas
Directed by: Geetu Mohandas
Produced by: KVN Productions & Monster Mind Creations

𝗧𝗼 𝗦𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗺 & 𝗗𝗼𝘄𝗻𝗹𝗼𝗮𝗱 𝗙𝘂𝗹𝗹 𝗦𝗼𝗻𝗴:
Spotify - https://bit.ly/40HGcWM
JioSaavn - https://bit.ly/4r64g0r
Gaana - https://bit.ly/4cj2wxf
iTunes - https://apple.co/4b08NLV
Apple Music - https://apple.co/4b08NLV
Amazon Prime Music - https://amzn.to/4aIOT9n
YouTube Music - https://bit.ly/46A0DIV

Lyrics:
तोड़ो, सारे उसूलों को
छोड़ो, जाने दो भूलो को
तू हो बाहों में Aur  हर जगह तबाही
तबाही तबाही तबाही तबाही तबाही ..

Todo, Saare Usoolon Ko
Chhodo, Jaane Do Bhoolo Ko
Tu Ho Baahon Mein Aur Har Jagah Tabaahi
Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi ..

ये लहर, ये हवा
कब चली पूछ के
रूह पे, क्यूँ भला
हो कोई बंदिशें
दुनिया के दस्तूर से आज ले रिहाई
तबाही तबाही तबाही तबाही तबाही ..

Yeh Lahar, Yeh Hawaa
Kab Chali Poochke
Rooh Pe, Kyun Bhala
Ho Koi Bandishein
Duniya Ke Dastoor Se Aaj Le Rihaayii
Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi ..

तू मुझे छील दे सांस की आग से
हर धड़क पे दोनो हो फना राख से
हर गलत सही-रेत पे लिखी गवाही
तबाही तबाही तबाही तबाही तबाही

Tu Mujhe Chheel De, Saans Ki Aag Se
Har Dhadak Pe Dono Ho Fana Raakh Se
Har Galat Sahi- Ret Pe Likhi Gawaahi
Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi ..

#Tabaahi #Toxic #ToxicAFairyTale #Yash #RockingStarYash #GeetuMohandas #KiaraAdvani

snippet.title: Ve Junoon | Awarapan 2 | Emraan Hashmi, Disha Patani | Vishesh Bhatt | Mithoon, Sayeed Q., Subodhh
snippet.description:
Phir ishq karne chala kyun?
 
Beginning the musical journey of ‘Awarapan 2’, ‘Ve Junoon’ is composed by Mithoon, sung by Subodhh Sharma and penned by Sayeed Quadri. Featuring Emraan Hashmi and Disha Patani in the video, this song is yearning in its purest form.
 
#VeJunoon #Awarapan2 #EmraanHashmi #DishaPatani #Mithoon #SayeedQuadri #SubodhhSharma
 
Song Composed and Arranged by Mithoon
Lyrics: Sayeed Quadri
Singer: Subodhh Sharma
Song Creative Head: Anugrah
Music Production: Godswill Mergulhão
Music Assistants: Anugrah, Godswill Mergulhão, Eli Rodrigues & Kaushal Gohil
Guitars: Kalyan Baruah
Violin: Jitu Thakur
Backing Vocals: Abhishek Nailwal, Mihir Sharma & Kaustubh More
Recorded at Livingwater Music by A Manivannan
Song Mixed & Mastered by Eric Pillai at Future Sound of Bombay
Assistant Mixing Engineer: Michael Edwin Pillai
Music Head Vishesh Films: Rohit Saini
 
Starring Emraan Hashmi, Disha Patani, Shabana Azmi, Suvinder Vicky, Vijayant Kohli, Aniruddh Rawal, Atul Kumar
 
Vishesh Films & Mukesh Bhatt Present
A Vishesh Bhatt Production
 
AWARAPAN 2
Produced By Vishesh Bhatt
Directed By Nitin Kakkar
Director of Photography Vishnu Rao
Editor Devendra Murdeshwar
Production Designer Teena Paradkar
Choreographer Mudassar Khan
 
Theatrical Distribution Pen Marudhar
In Cinemas 14th August 2026
 
Lyrics:

Intro
 
Chaha tha tune jisse Paaya kabhi na usse
 
Tujhko toh sab hai pataa, aye dil Saari khabar hai tujhe
 
Banjar hui hai aankhen Veeran hai ye saansen
Ab meri rooh ko na jalaa...naa jalaa
 
Aage hai teri marzi Karle tu ye khudgarzi
Hona hai hojaa tabaah...haan tabaah
 
Chorus
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil lutne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil mitne chalaa kyun..haaye
 
Phir Ishq karne chalaa kyun OOOOOOOOO..
Dil lutne chalaa kyun OOOOOOOOO..
Dil mitne chalaa kyun..haaye Phir Ishq karne chala kyun…
 
( Music )
 
OOOOOOOOOO.. OOOOOOOOOO..
 
Verse 1
 
Dekha hai pehle kahin Aisa laga kyun usse
 
Shaayad mere dard se kahin Waqif laga woh mujhe
 
Marham laga zakhmon pe Raahat mili kuchh phirse
Dil ko sukoon milaa..haan milaaaa
 
Aage hai teri marzi Karle tu ye khudgarzi
Hona hai hojaa tabaah...haan tabaah
 
Chorus
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil lutne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil mitne chalaa kyun, haaye
 
Phir Ishq karne chalaa kyun…
 
(Music)
 
Tararareiyeee yeeeeee…
 
Verse 2
 
Aisi koi daastaan
Hai dil main uske kahin Zikr woh jiska kabhi magar Khud se bhi karta nahin
 
Rakhta chhupa ke sabse Bhulaa hai jaise rakh ke
Kal woh kahin apna…..apnaaa Aage hai teri marzi
 
Karle tu ye khudgarzi
Hona hai hojaa tabaah...haan tabaah
 
Chorus
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil lutne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil mitne chalaa kyun….haaye
 
Phir ishq karne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junooooooooooooooo Oooooooooo Oooooooooo Ooooooooooo
Ve Junooooooooooooooo Oooooooooo Oooooooooo Ooooooooooo
 
Dil ishq karne chalaa kyun Hmmmmmm…..
Phir ishq karne chalaa kyun

snippet.title: Dune: Part Three | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
“Forgive me for all I’ve done” Experience the epic conclusion. Dune: Part Three only in theaters and IMAX December 18. #DuneMovie#FilmedforIMAX

From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion.

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

The film stars Oscar nominee Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Oscar nominee Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach de Bankolé, with Oscar nominee Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Oscar winner Javier Bardem.

Villeneuve directs from a screenplay by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novels written by Frank Herbert. The film is produced by Oscar nominees Mary Parent, Cale Boyter, Villeneuve and Tanya Lapointe, and Joe Caracciolo, and executive produced by Joshua Grode, Thomas Tull, Herbert W. Gains, Brian Herbert, Byron Merritt, Kim Herbert, Kevin J. Anderson, Richard P. Rubinstein, John Harrison and Jessica Derhammer.

Joining Villeneuve behind the camera are Oscar-winning director of photography Linus Sandgren, Oscar-winning production designer Patrice Vermette, Oscar-winning editor Joe Walker, Oscar nominated costume designer Jacqueline West, Oscar-nominated casting director Francine Maisler, and Oscar-winning composer Hans Zimmer.

Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures Present A Legendary Pictures Production, A Film By Denis Villeneuve, Dune: Part Three, only in theaters and IMAX® across North America on December 18, 2026 and internationally beginning 16 December 2026. The film will be distributed worldwide by Warner Bros. Pictures and in China by Legendary East.

bn.title: Toxic | ট্রেলার গানের ধারণা | রকিং স্টার ইয়াশ | গীতু মোহানদাস | কেভিএন | মনস্টার মাইন্ড ক্রিয়েশনস
bn.description:
#টক্সিকট্রেলার #রকিংস্টারযশ #গীতুমোহনদাস #কেভিএনপ্রোডাকশনস আজ জানে কি জিদ না করো গান টক্সিক

#টক্সিক : প্রেম, বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা এবং প্রতিশোধ এক বিপজ্জনক ও রোমাঞ্চকর কাহিনিতে এসে মিলেছে।

💥 এক নতুন অ্যান্টি-হিরোর উত্থানের জন্য প্রস্তুত হন! টক্সিক (২০২৫) একটি ডার্ক, অ্যাকশন-প্যাকড থ্রিলার, যেখানে রকিং স্টার যশকে এক অভূতপূর্ব অবতারে দেখা যাবে। গীতু মোহনদাস পরিচালিত এবং কেভিএন প্রোডাকশনস ও মনস্টার মাইন্ড ক্রিয়েশনস প্রযোজিত এই কনসেপ্ট ট্রেলারটি বিশৃঙ্খলা, অপরাধ এবং প্রতিশোধের এক জগতের ঝলক দেখায়। অপেক্ষার অবসান! টক্সিক-এর রোমাঞ্চকর কনসেপ্ট ট্রেলারটি দেখুন, যেখানে অভিনয় করেছেন আর কেউ নন, রকিং স্টার যশ এক অভূতপূর্ব অবতারে। দূরদর্শী গীতু মোহনদাস পরিচালিত এবং কেভিএন প্রোডাকশনস প্রযোজিত এই সিনেম্যাটিক স্পেকট্যাকলটি অ্যাকশনকে নতুনভাবে সংজ্ঞায়িত করতে চলেছে। উত্তেজনা।

মনস্টার মাইন্ড ক্রিয়েশনস-এর সেরা ভিজ্যুয়াল এবং অ্যাড্রেনালিন-পাম্পিং সাউন্ডট্র্যাকের সাথে, 'টক্সিক' একটি রোমাঞ্চকর অভিজ্ঞতার প্রতিশ্রুতি দেয় যা আপনাকে আরও বেশি কিছু চাইতে বাধ্য করবে!

'টক্সিক'-এর অফিসিয়াল ট্রেলারের সাথে একটি তীব্র সিনেম্যাটিক যাত্রার জন্য প্রস্তুত হন! ক্যারিশম্যাটিক যশ, অনবদ্য নয়নতারা এবং প্রতিভাবান হুমা কোরেশি অভিনীত এই চলচ্চিত্রটি একটি আকর্ষণীয় আখ্যান এবং দুর্দান্ত অভিনয়ের প্রতিশ্রুতি দেয়। গীতু মোহনদাস পরিচালিত, ট্রেলারটি নাটক এবং সাসপেন্সে ভরা একটি রোমাঞ্চকর গল্পের আভাস দেয়। এই মহাকাব্যিক অভিযানটি মিস করবেন না!

snippet.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day - Hidden Heroes Vignette - Only In Cinemas July 29
snippet.description:
Peter Parker is always making the hard decisions. #SpiderManBrandNewDay is only in cinemas July 29, in Premium Large Formats & 3D.

Book tickets now: www.sonypictures.co.uk/movies/spider-man-brand-new-day

It's a BRAND NEW DAY for Peter Parker. Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn’t remember him -- and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him -- sparks a change in Peter he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

The world may have forgotten Peter Parker, but he hasn’t forgotten them.

snippet.title: GODZILLA MINUS ZERO | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Returning to zero is not an option.

GODZILLA MINUS ZERO
VFX, Written, and Directed by Takashi Yamazaki

In theatres November 6
Follow @godzilla_toho and @GKIDSfilms for more updates!
godzillaminuszero.com

GODZILLA MINUS ZERO picks up in 1949, two years after the tumultuous events of Godzilla Minus One, and continues the story of the Shikishima family as they face an all-new calamity. 

As a project Filmed For IMAX, GODZILLA MINUS ZERO was shot with high-definition digital cameras certified by IMAX, and optimized in sound and imagery unique to IMAX screens. Fans can look forward to seeing Godzilla presented to all new terrifying heights, making GODZILLA MINUS ZERO a true cinematic event not to be missed.

hi.title: गॉडज़िला माइनस ज़ीरो | आधिकारिक टीज़र
hi.description:
शून्य पर लौटना कोई विकल्प नहीं है।

गॉडज़िला माइनस ज़ीरो
वीएफएक्स, लेखन और निर्देशन: ताकाशी यामाज़ाकी

6 नवंबर को सिनेमाघरों में
अधिक अपडेट के लिए @godzilla_toho और @GKIDSfilms को फॉलो करें!
godzillaminuszero.com

गॉडज़िला माइनस ज़ीरो की कहानी 1949 में शुरू होती है, जो गॉडज़िला माइनस वन की उथल-पुथल भरी घटनाओं के दो साल बाद का समय है, और शिकिशिमा परिवार की कहानी को आगे बढ़ाती है, जब वे एक नई विपत्ति का सामना करते हैं।

आईमैक्स के लिए फिल्माई गई इस फिल्म, गॉडज़िला माइनस ज़ीरो को आईमैक्स द्वारा प्रमाणित हाई-डेफिनिशन डिजिटल कैमरों से शूट किया गया है, और आईमैक्स स्क्रीन के लिए अद्वितीय ध्वनि और इमेजरी को अनुकूलित किया गया है। प्रशंसक गॉडज़िला को एक नए भयावह रूप में देखने के लिए उत्सुक हैं, जो गॉडज़िला माइनस ज़ीरो को एक ऐसा सिनेमाई अनुभव बनाता है जिसे देखना न भूलें।

id.title: GODZILLA MINUS ZERO | Teaser Resmi
id.description:
Kembali ke titik nol bukanlah pilihan.

GODZILLA MINUS ZERO
Efek Visual, Penulis, dan Sutradara oleh Takashi Yamazaki

Tayang di bioskop 6 November
Ikuti @godzilla_toho dan @GKIDSfilms untuk informasi lebih lanjut!

godzillaminuszero.com

GODZILLA MINUS ZERO berlatar tahun 1949, dua tahun setelah peristiwa dahsyat Godzilla Minus One, dan melanjutkan kisah keluarga Shikishima saat mereka menghadapi malapetaka baru.

Sebagai proyek yang Difilmkan untuk IMAX, GODZILLA MINUS ZERO difilmkan dengan kamera digital definisi tinggi yang disertifikasi oleh IMAX, dan dioptimalkan dalam suara dan gambar yang unik untuk layar IMAX. Para penggemar dapat menantikan Godzilla yang ditampilkan dengan tingkat kengerian yang baru, menjadikan GODZILLA MINUS ZERO sebuah peristiwa sinematik sejati yang tidak boleh dilewatkan.

de-DE.title: GODZILLA MINUS ZERO | Offizieller Teaser
de-DE.description:

GODZILLA MINUS ZERO setzt im Jahr 1949 ein, zwei Jahre nach den turbulenten Ereignissen von Godzilla Minus One, und erzählt die Geschichte der Familie Shikishima weiter, die sich einer neuen Katastrophe stellen muss.

Als IMAX-Projekt wurde GODZILLA MINUS ZERO mit hochauflösenden, IMAX-zertifizierten Digitalkameras gedreht und für IMAX-Leinwände optimiert. Fans können sich auf Godzilla in völlig neuen, furchterregenden Dimensionen freuen – GODZILLA MINUS ZERO ist ein echtes Kinoerlebnis, das man nicht verpassen sollte.

എന്താണ് Roblox? എല്ലാ പ്രായത്തിലുമുള്ള കുട്ടികൾക്ക് സുരക്ഷിതമായി ഇടപഴകാനും സൃഷ്ടിക്കാനും ആസ്വദിക്കാനും പഠിക്കാനും കഴിയുന്ന ഒരു ഓൺലൈൻ വെർച്വൽ കളിസ്ഥലവും വർക്ക്ഷോപ്പുമാണ് ROBLOX. ROBLOX-ലെ പ്രായോഗികമായി എല്ലാം കമ്മ്യൂണിറ്റിയിലെ അംഗങ്ങൾ രൂപകൽപ്പന ചെയ്യുകയും നിർമ്മിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു എന്നതാണ് ഇതിന്റെ പ്രത്യേകത. ഓരോ കളിക്കാരനും ഒരു അവതാർ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത് അതിന് ഒരു ഐഡന്റിറ്റി നൽകിക്കൊണ്ടാണ് ആരംഭിക്കുന്നത്. തുടർന്ന് അവർക്ക് ROBLOX പര്യവേക്ഷണം ചെയ്യാൻ കഴിയും - മറ്റുള്ളവരുമായി ചാറ്റ് ചെയ്തുകൊണ്ടോ, ഗെയിമുകൾ കളിച്ചോ, അല്ലെങ്കിൽ സൃഷ്ടിപരമായ പ്രോജക്റ്റുകളിൽ സഹകരിച്ചോ ഇടപഴകി. ഓരോ കളിക്കാരനും സ്വന്തമായി വികസിപ്പിക്കാത്ത റിയൽ എസ്റ്റേറ്റിന്റെ ഒരു ഭാഗം നൽകുന്നു, അതോടൊപ്പം എന്തും രൂപകൽപ്പന ചെയ്യാനും നിർമ്മിക്കാനും കഴിയുന്ന ഒരു വെർച്വൽ ടൂൾബോക്സും നൽകുന്നു - അത് ഒരു നാവിഗേറ്റ് ചെയ്യാവുന്ന അംബരചുംബി, പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്ന ഹെലികോപ്റ്റർ, ഒരു ഭീമൻ പിൻബോൾ മെഷീൻ, ഒരു മൾട്ടിപ്ലെയർ "ക്യാപ്ചർ ദി ഫ്ലാഗ്" ഗെയിം അല്ലെങ്കിൽ മറ്റേതെങ്കിലും, ഇതുവരെ സ്വപ്നം കാണാത്ത സൃഷ്ടി എന്നിവ ആകാം. വെർച്വൽ ഭൂമിയുടെ ഈ ആദ്യ പ്ലോട്ടിന് യാതൊരു ചെലവുമില്ല. പങ്കെടുക്കുന്നതിലൂടെയും രസകരമായ കാര്യങ്ങൾ നിർമ്മിക്കുന്നതിലൂടെയും, ROBLOX അംഗങ്ങൾക്ക് സ്പെഷ്യാലിറ്റി ബാഡ്ജുകളും ROBLOX ഡോളറുകളും ("Robux") നേടാൻ കഴിയും. അതാകട്ടെ, അവതാർ വസ്ത്രങ്ങളും അനുബന്ധ ഉപകരണങ്ങളും വാങ്ങാൻ ഓൺലൈൻ കാറ്റലോഗ് ഷോപ്പുചെയ്യാനും പ്രീമിയം നിർമ്മാണ സാമഗ്രികൾ, സംവേദനാത്മക ഘടകങ്ങൾ, പ്രവർത്തന സംവിധാനങ്ങൾ എന്നിവ വാങ്ങാനും അവർക്ക് കഴിയും.

రోబ్లాక్స్ అంటే ఏమిటి? రోబ్లాక్స్ అనేది ఒక ఆన్‌లైన్ వర్చువల్ ఆటస్థలం మరియు వర్క్‌షాప్. ఇక్కడ అన్ని వయసుల పిల్లలు సురక్షితంగా ఒకరితో ఒకరు సంభాషించుకోవచ్చు, సృష్టించవచ్చు, ఆనందించవచ్చు మరియు నేర్చుకోవచ్చు. దీని ప్రత్యేకత ఏమిటంటే, రోబ్లాక్స్‌లోని దాదాపు ప్రతిదీ కమ్యూనిటీ సభ్యులచే రూపొందించబడి మరియు నిర్మించబడింది. ప్రతి ఆటగాడు ఒక అవతార్‌ను ఎంచుకుని, దానికి ఒక గుర్తింపును ఇవ్వడం ద్వారా ఆటను ప్రారంభిస్తారు. ఆ తర్వాత వారు చాటింగ్ చేయడం, ఆటలు ఆడటం లేదా సృజనాత్మక ప్రాజెక్టులలో కలిసి పనిచేయడం ద్వారా ఇతరులతో సంభాషిస్తూ ROBLOXను అన్వేషించవచ్చు. ప్రతి ఆటగాడికి వారి స్వంత అభివృద్ధి చెందని భూభాగంతో పాటు, ఒక వర్చువల్ టూల్‌బాక్స్ కూడా ఇవ్వబడుతుంది. దానితో వారు దేనినైనా డిజైన్ చేసి నిర్మించవచ్చు — అది ప్రయాణించగల ఆకాశహర్మ్యం కావచ్చు, పనిచేసే హెలికాప్టర్ కావచ్చు, ఒక పెద్ద పిన్‌బాల్ మెషిన్ కావచ్చు, మల్టీప్లేయర్ “క్యాప్చర్ ది ఫ్లాగ్” గేమ్ కావచ్చు లేదా ఇంకా ఊహించని మరేదైనా సృష్టి కావచ్చు. ఈ మొదటి వర్చువల్ భూభాగానికి ఎటువంటి ఖర్చు ఉండదు. పాల్గొనడం ద్వారా మరియు అద్భుతమైన వస్తువులను నిర్మించడం ద్వారా, ROBLOX సభ్యులు ప్రత్యేక బ్యాడ్జ్‌లతో పాటు ROBLOX డాలర్లను (“రోబక్స్”) సంపాదించవచ్చు. దానికి బదులుగా, వారు ఆన్‌లైన్ కేటలాగ్‌లో షాపింగ్ చేసి అవతార్ దుస్తులు మరియు యాక్సెసరీలతో పాటు ప్రీమియం నిర్మాణ సామగ్రి, ఇంటరాక్టివ్ భాగాలు మరియు పనిచేసే యంత్రాంగాలను కొనుగోలు చేయవచ్చు.

snippet.title: Barsaat - Banjaare (Official Video)
snippet.description:
Sometimes the hardest thing is not losing someone.

It’s accepting that they have already moved on.

“Barsaat” is a story of a girl who loved with all her heart but was left behind by the person she trusted the most. While he moved on, she remained stuck between memories, questions and hope.

She keeps saying:
“Tne meri yaad ave gi”

Not because she wants revenge.
Not because she hates him.

But because she believes nobody will ever love him the way she did.

As the song unfolds, the pain slowly turns into acceptance. And in the end, she chooses peace over holding on.

Barsaat follows her emotional journey through four stages:

Denial
“Tne meri yaad ave gi”

Pain
“Anshu mere rukhte nhi”

Acceptance
“Ek bar chod gye jo, v mud k dubara ande na”

Letting Go
“Jde rhve raji rhiye rr”

If you’ve ever loved someone who couldn’t stay, this song is for you.

If Barsaat feels personal to you, share your story with us.
Tell us about a heartbreak that changed you, how you healed, and what you’d say to someone who is struggling today.

Some of the people who share their stories will be invited to Delhi and featured in the official Barsaat music video shoot.

Your story could become the reason someone else finds hope. ❤️

Your words might help someone who is struggling today.

#Barsaat #Banjaare #Bairan 

Credits
Song Credits 
Title: Barsaat
Singer/Lyrics/Composer: BANJAARE
Music: Roni x Banjaare
Mix- Master: Gurie
Animation: The Quirky i

Lyrics:

Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tod ke nai chaal padya tu

Ban kaali raat chhaavegi
Tanne meri yaad aavegi

Ke pyaar isa milna nahi
Kaun mere jisa chaavegi
Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tanne meri yaad aavegi

Ke tanne meri yaad aavegi
Tanne meri yaad aavegi
Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tanne meri yaad aavegi

Ya to manne maar jyaanda re
Nyu kyun manne chhod ke gaya
Aansu mere rukte nahi
Isa dil tod ke gaya

Main khul ke nai roya karungi
Jab barsaat aavegi
Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tanne meri yaad aavegi

Ke pyaar isa milna nahi
Kaun mere jisa chaavegi
Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu haaye
Tanne meri yaad aavegi

Sapne sajaaye jaande na
Apne bhulaaye jaande na

Ek baar chhod gaye jo
Mud ke dubaara aande na

Ke sapne sajaaye jaande na
Apne bhulaaye jaande na
Ek baar chhod gaye jo
Mud ke dubaara aande na

Main teri e thi, teri e rahun
Jab tak saans aavegi

Chhod ke nai chaal padya tu
Tanne meri yaad aavegi
Ke tanne meri...

Tu jade rahve raaji rahiye re
Jaan tai bhi pyaara tha re tu
Basde ujaad ke gaya
Kisa banjaara tha re tu

#barsaat #banjaare

snippet.description:
The madness has officially begun! 🔥🎶

Get ready for a fresh wave of nostalgia as the lyrical video of 'Ucha Lamba Kad Forever' is finally here! Presented by Junglee Music, this electrifying track from Welcome to the Jungle brings together the blockbuster pairing of Akshay Kumar and Disha Patani for a celebration packed with energy, fun, and unforgettable vibes.

Sung by Anand Raj Anand and Rubai, 'Ucha Lamba Kad Forever' revives the iconic party spirit with a modern twist, promising to get everyone grooving once again.

Credits :

Song: Sabse Hum Door Huye
Album: Kal Ki Awaz
Artist: Kumar Sanu | Sadhana Sargam
Music Director: Nadeem-Shravan
Lyricist: Sameer 



Lyrics :

sabse hum dur hue tumse milne ke baad
sabse hum dur hue tumse milne ke baad
ishk me chur hue tumse milne ke baad
sabse hum dur hue tumse milne ke baad
sabse hum dur hue tumse milne ke baad
kitne magrur hue tumse milne ke baad
sabse hum dur hue tumse milne ke baad

pahle to na lagti thi dunia itni pyari
pahle to kabhi bhi na thi aisi bekarari
halka halka dard hai koi halka sa nasha
aise aalam me bhi mujhko aata hai maja
jakham nasur hue tumse milne ke baad
sabse hum dur hue tumse milne ke baad
sabse hum dur hue tumse milne ke baad

imtiha mohabbat main bhi kabhi lunga
ishq me tujhe dil ja apni jan dunga
tu jo kahde to mai chodunga sara jaha
jina kya marna bhi muskil hai ab tere bina
kitne magrur hue tumse milne ke baad
sabse hum dur hue tumse milne ke baad
sabse hum dur hue tumse milne ke baad

aaja pas aaja tujhse sine se laga lu
barso ki betabiyo ko aaj mai mita du
teri chahat mere dil me hai ab subah sham
mere hotho pe hai bas ek tera nam
kitne magrur hue tumse milne ke baad
sabse hum dur hue tumse milne ke baad
sabse hum dur hue tumse milne ke baad
ishk me chur hue tumse milne ke baad
sabse hum dur hue tumse milne ke baad
sabse hum dur hue tumse milne ke baad
kitne magrur hue tumse milne ke baad

snippet.title: Mera Koi Nhi – Aarzoo Khaan | Emotional Hindi Sad Song | New Song 2026 | Arijit Singh Vibe
snippet.description:
Mera Koi Nhi – Aarzoo Khaan | Emotional Hindi Sad Song | New Song 2026 | Arijit Singh Vibe


---



Mera koi nhi...
bas tanhai hi meri humsafar hai.

Jin logon ko
apna samjha tha...
waqt badalte hi
wo bhi badal gaye.

Ab na kisi se
koi shikayat hai...
na kisi se koi umeed...
bas khud se hi
baatein kar leta hoon.

“Mera Koi Nhi”
ek aise dil ki kahani hai
jo apno ko khokar bhi
khamoshi se jeena seekh gaya.

Har muskurahat ke peeche
ek dard chhupa hai...
aur har khamoshi me
teri yaad basti hai.

Is gaane mein
dard bhi hai,
tanhai bhi hai,
aur ek gehra ehsaas bhi
jo dheere se kehta hai —

mera koi nhi...
bas yaadein hi mere saath hain...

Agar aapne bhi
kabhi kisi ko
apni rooh se zyada chaha ho
aur aaj khud ko akela mehsoos karte ho,
to ye gaana
aapke dil ko chhoo jaayega.

Mera Koi Nhi – Aarzoo Khaan | Emotional Hindi Sad Song | New Song 2026 | Arijit Singh Vibe


---



Mera koi nhi...
bas tanhai hi meri humsafar hai.

Jin logon ko
apna samjha tha...
waqt badalte hi
wo bhi badal gaye.

Ab na kisi se
koi shikayat hai...
na kisi se koi umeed...
bas khud se hi
baatein kar leta hoon.

“Mera Koi Nhi”
ek aise dil ki kahani hai
jo apno ko khokar bhi
khamoshi se jeena seekh gaya.

Har muskurahat ke peeche
ek dard chhupa hai...
aur har khamoshi me
teri yaad basti hai.

Is gaane mein
dard bhi hai,
tanhai bhi hai,
aur ek gehra ehsaas bhi
jo dheere se kehta hai —

mera koi nhi...
bas yaadein hi mere saath hain...

Agar aapne bhi
kabhi kisi ko
apni rooh se zyada chaha ho
aur aaj khud ko akela mehsoos karte ho,
to ye gaana
aapke dil ko chhoo jaayega.

snippet.description:
TOP 06 Alikad Ye Mala Palidkad Ne Panduranga | Nadi Bharli Chandrabhaga  | Vitthal Bhaktigeet | Pandharpur Wari Special | Vithu Mauli | Vitthal Bhajans @sumeetmarathibhakti 

गायक: नंदू नेटके, उत्तरा केळकर, प्रतिभा थोरात, रमेश सिताराम बुवा पाटील(नान्हेनकर), श्री गणेश महाराज भगत, रोमियो कांबळे.
संगीत: मिलिंद मोहिते, सिताराम बुवा नान्हेनकर, श्री गणेश महाराज भगत, महेशराज साळुंके, संदीप योगेश, रोमियो कांबळे, चंद्रशेखर गाडगीळ.
गीत: सोपान कोकाटे, सागर पवार, सिताराम बुवा नान्हेनकर, विनोद खटके, 
साईनाथ पाटोळे.

📌 Timeline:
१. अलीकडं ये मला पलीकडे ने पांडुरंगा          00:00
२. देह देवाचे मंदिर                                       05:00
३. विठ्ठला विठ्ठला                                        10:19

५. मन माऊली माऊली झालया                      20:25
६. कलियुगामध्ये न्याय बुडाला                       27:03

🙏 पुंडलिक वरदा हरी विठ्ठल! जय हरी विठ्ठल! 🙏

विठ्ठल भक्तांसाठी सादर आहे TOP 06 "अलीकडे ये मला पलीकडे ने पांडुरंगा" हा भावपूर्ण विठ्ठल भक्तिगीतांचा संग्रह.

या गीतांमधून भक्ताची पांडुरंगाच्या चरणी पोहोचण्याची तळमळ, अखंड श्रद्धा आणि विठ्ठलनामाची गोडी अनुभवायला मिळते. वारकरी संप्रदायातील भक्ती, प्रेम आणि समर्पणाचा सुंदर संगम या संग्रहात आहे.

🎵 या संग्रहात:

जब हाल-ए-दिल तुमसे कहने मैं मिलने आती हूँ
पर देख तेरा दीवानापन मैं सोच में पड़ जाती हूँ
जब हाल-ए-दिल ...

दिल तो दीवाना है मैने जाना है

इश्क़ वाले किसी आग से न डरें
प्यार की राह में भी मर के भी वो चलें
चाहे कुछ भी अब हो जाए तेरे प्यार में
है प्यार बिना रखा भी क्या इस संसार में

पर देख तेरा दीवानापन ...

आहें भरने लगा ये दिल-ए-बेकरार
तुमसे ही ज़िंदगी में ऐ सनम थी बहार
तू चैन मेरा तू प्यार मेरा ओ जान-ए-जिगर
मेरे प्यार तू ऐ जान-ए-वफ़ा क्यों है बेखबर
मैं रात और दिन गीत बस तेरे ही गुनगुनाती हूँ

Percorre la via dell'amore anche se muore.

Non importa cosa accada nel vostro amore.

Tu, amore mio, sei stata la primavera nella mia vita.

Eppure non ti ho dimenticato.
